R4D-deer-drive-0002.name: 220 m S of Upper Arrow Lake
R4D-deer-drive-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-4-001 unit 98 (official), right here. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2017 (9 years old), right here.
Burn from 2018 (fire N52884, 61 ha), 260 m SE.
NW facing slope, 9 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 1.3 km NW: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Hwy 6 20 m SE: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 21 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 6.
Park: 50.1056, -117.84661, pull off on Hwy 6 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: none. The spot is at the road.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2017 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-15, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season: mule deer 4 point bucks Sept 10 to Nov 10 and more rows (synopsis page 39, 99%). 3 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-deer-drive-0002.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 4-15: about 2,707 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.51 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
